notes: Network: all 8 About-panel URLs returned 000 with curl -m 12, one at a time, so the sandbox network looks restricted; none was retried and each is reported as unreachable-link. Typos: no doubled words or common misspellings found in the visible strings. Sources: the eight links in the About Sources list all match research.sources with verified:true. Research record: research.sources[1] (IDL JULDAY) has a note saying its example gives 2299161 for 5 October 1582, while fact 2 says 15 October 1582; the page's statement matches the verified Julian day article, so the research note should be corrected. The winnerNotes call France, Denmark-Norway and Soviet Russia 'solid', but no research.facts entry records them. Calculations: every dated example on the page (weekdays, day numbers, the 1731/32 readings, the 1700 and 1900 leap-day cases, the 1642 and 1917 conversions) was recomputed independently and agrees. Visitor text at index.html line 413 says 'Named by the review step of this build', which exposes internal process wording; left for the owner, not reported as a finding.
